tieu_de: Junior/Middle FullStack Engineer Python, Java, NodeJS
mo_ta_cong_viec:
Educational Background Requirements:
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or other relevant technical disciplines.
Expected Technical Competency Areas:
Operating systems: UNIX/Linux
Programming languages: Python, C++, Java, Bash scripts, Node JS & React JS…
Databases, Data Storage and Data Platforms: SQL (PostgreSQL), CockroachDB, DuckDB, S3 Storage
Messaging systems and workflow integration: Kafka, AMQP, Apache Airflow, Temporal, N8N
Cloud services and infrastructures: VM, containers, Kubernetes, IaC (infrastructure-as-code)
Data pipelines & products: ETL, plugins/connectors to data sources, Change Data Cap-ture (CDC)
Microservices, Design Patterns, Test Driven Development, Logging
Workplace Type:
On-site (Downtown Ho Chi Minh City)
Employment Type:
Full-time
Introduction:
kSynerX is seeking highly motivated full-time employees specializing in full-stack software service engineering to join our Development & Engineering (D&E) team in Ho Chi Minh City.
The D&E team is responsible for designing, developing, and continuously improving kSynerX’s core technology products. This role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to pioneering advancements in smart and intelligent decision-making based on data analytics and AI/ML algorithms.
Key Responsibilities:
Create and manage efficient data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and transforming large volumes of data.
Integrate data from diverse data sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
Engineer and optimize software services performance and efficiency.
Translate user requirements to technical solutions for front-end and backend software services
Develop full stack of front-end and corresponding back-end service-based components
Design and implement backend multi-protocol services for data integration and AI/ML serving
Support integration of smart algorithms, data connectors, data transformation/ingestions pipelines into services, data pipelines, and automated workflows into services
Perform other related duties as assigned.
Review code and provide constructive feedback
yeu_cau:
Work experience as a Python, C++, Java, Node JS Developer

Knowledge of object-relational mapping (ORM) and Pydantic Models
Familiarity with front-end technologies (like JavaScript and HTML5) React JS, Net JS
Strong programming skills in React.js and Node.js, Java and Python
Good knowledge for optimizing applications for performance and user experience
Good experience with database related to SQL, NoSQL
Strong knowledge about front-end application performance and backend performance
Good experiences in integration with RESTful and messaging systems APIs
Good experience with SQL, UNIX/Linux environments, and scripting languages.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and effective communication skills.
